plain: Weakness or ailment of body or character.

webster.text: An unsound or unhealthy state of the body; weakness; feebleness.

more.text: Weakness of mind; failing; fault; foible.
Any particular disease; malady; applied rather to chronic, than to violent diseases.
Defect; imperfection; weakness; as the infirmities of a constitution of government.

example.quote: All that need be remarked is, that a body which is to correct this infirmity ought itself to be free from it, and consequently ought to be less numerous.
